description: This file defines the 'Url' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library' namespace. The class provides methods to parse, manipulate, and generate URLs, including adding rewrite rules and creating links with query parameters.

classes.name: Url
classes.description: A class for handling URL parsing, manipulation, and generation, supporting rewrites and encapsulating URL components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Url object by parsing the provided URL string into its components.

methods.name: addRewrite
methods.description: Adds a rewrite object that implements a 'rewrite' method to the URL rewriting system.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Generates and returns a URL string based on the route, arguments, and rewrite rules, optionally compatible with JavaScript context.

search-terms: generate link with route and args
